XECH Hydroboil Pro Black Electric Kettle 700ml – Compact, Fast & Safe Boiling

The XECH Hydroboil Pro Black Electric Kettle 700ml is designed for modern lifestyles where speed, safety, and portability matter most. Whether you are preparing tea, coffee, instant noodles, or hot water for daily use, this electric kettle delivers fast boiling performance with a 500 W heating element that efficiently heats up to 700 ml of water in minutes.

Crafted with a cool-touch body, the kettle ensures safe handling even when the water inside is boiling, making it ideal for homes with children or busy office environments. Its compact and portable design makes it an excellent choice for travel, small kitchens, hostels, and workspaces where space is limited.

Fast Heating with 500W Power

Equipped with a powerful yet energy-efficient 500 W heating element, the XECH Hydroboil Pro electric kettle ensures rapid boiling without excessive power consumption. This makes it a reliable option for daily use while keeping electricity usage under control. The 700ml capacity is perfect for single users or small servings, reducing water waste and heating time.

Safe & User-Friendly Cool-Touch Design

Safety is a key highlight of the The advanced cool-touch exterior remains comfortable to hold even when the water reaches boiling temperature. This feature minimizes the risk of burns and enhances overall user confidence during handling and pouring.

Portable & Travel-Friendly

Thanks to its compact size and lightweight build, this is highly portable and travel-ready. It easily fits into luggage, making it suitable for business trips, vacations, hotel stays, and student accommodations. Whether at home, in the office, or on the go, this kettle adapts seamlessly to your lifestyle.

Premium Matte Finish – Black & Blue Options

The kettle features a stylish premium matte finish available in elegant Black and Blue color variants. Its modern aesthetic blends effortlessly with contemporary kitchens, office desks, and travel setups. The sleek design not only looks premium but also resists fingerprints and smudges for a cleaner appearance.

Advanced Safety Features

Built with essential safety mechanisms, the includes boil-dry protection and automatic shut-off. These features prevent damage by switching off the kettle when there is no water or once the water reaches boiling point, ensuring safe operation and extended product life.

  • 700ml electric kettle – ideal for daily and personal use
  • 500 W heating element for fast and efficient boiling
  • Cool-touch body for safe handling during operation
  • Compact and portable design for travel, office, or home
  • Premium matte finish available in Black and Blue
  • Boil-dry protection for added safety
  • Automatic shut-off after boiling
  • Easy to store and lightweight construction

Its blend of speed, safety, portability, and premium design makes it a smart investment for everyday convenience.
